name: Appleberry Farm
description: In West Suffield, CT, Appleberry Farm raises Raspberries, Apples, Pears, Peaches, and Pumpkins on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
